def get_moving_data(self, stopped_speed_threshold: Optional[float]=None,
    raw: bool=False, speed_extreemes_percentiles: float=
    IGNORE_TOP_SPEED_PERCENTILES, ignore_nonstandard_distances: bool=True
    ) ->MovingData:
    """
    Return a tuple of (moving_time, stopped_time, moving_distance,
    stopped_distance, max_speed) that may be used for detecting the time
    stopped, and max speed. Not that those values are not absolutely true,
    because the "stopped" or "moving" information aren't saved in the track.

    Because of errors in the GPS recording, it may be good to calculate
    them on a reduced and smoothed version of the track.

    Parameters
    ----------
    stopped_speed_threshold : float
        speeds (km/h) below this threshold are treated as if having no
        movement. Default is 1 km/h.

    Returns
    ----------
    moving_data : MovingData : named tuple
        moving_time : float
            time (seconds) of track in which movement was occurring
        stopped_time : float
            time (seconds) of track in which no movement was occurring
        stopped_distance : float
            distance (meters) travelled during stopped times
        moving_distance : float
            distance (meters) travelled during moving times
        max_speed : float
            Maximum speed (m/s) during the track.
    """
    if not stopped_speed_threshold:
        stopped_speed_threshold = DEFAULT_STOPPED_SPEED_THRESHOLD

    if raw:
        speed_extreemes_percentiles=0
        ignore_nonstandard_distances=False

    moving_time = 0.
    stopped_time = 0.

    moving_distance = 0.
    stopped_distance = 0.

    speeds_and_distances = []

    for track in self.tracks:
        track_moving_data = track.get_moving_data(stopped_speed_threshold, raw, speed_extreemes_percentiles, ignore_nonstandard_distances)
        if track_moving_data:
            moving_time += track_moving_data.moving_time
            stopped_time += track_moving_data.stopped_time
            moving_distance += track_moving_data.moving_distance
            stopped_distance += track_moving_data.stopped_distance
            if track_moving_data.max_speed is not None and track_moving_data.max_speed > 0:
                speeds_and_distances.append((track_moving_data.max_speed, 0))

    max_speed = 0.0
    if speeds_and_distances:
        # Extract just the speeds for max calculation
        speeds = [speed for speed, _ in speeds_and_distances]
        if speeds:
            # Sort speeds to calculate percentile
            sorted_speeds = sorted(speeds)
            if speed_extreemes_percentiles > 0:
                # Remove top percentiles
                remove_count = int(len(sorted_speeds) * speed_extreemes_percentiles)
                if remove_count > 0:
                    sorted_speeds = sorted_speeds[:-remove_count]
            if sorted_speeds:
                max_speed = max(sorted_speeds)
    
    return MovingData(moving_time, stopped_time, moving_distance, stopped_distance, max_speed)
